_note: Baidu photos of the terminal entrance at night and the control tower by day, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

cju-baidu-1.webp.zh: 夜幕下的济州机场：航站楼外立面上亮着“JEJU INT'L AIRPORT”标识，左侧是塔台，车道上有车辆经过。
cju-baidu-1.webp.en: Jeju at night, the JEJU INT'L AIRPORT sign lit on the terminal façade with the control tower to the left and traffic on the road.

cju-baidu-2.webp.zh: 白天从高架道路望向济州机场：圆形的塔台立在前景，棕榈树与接送车辆围绕航站楼入口。
cju-baidu-2.webp.en: Looking along the elevated roadway at Jeju, the round control tower rising above the terminal entrance, framed by palms and drop-off traffic.

cju-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，济州国际机场（CJU）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
cju-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Jeju International Airport (CJU) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
